title: Medical & TMAS
goal: Describe an injury, dictate vital signs and read back a doctor's advice.

l26-01.text: Ay! Cadet! My hand! The knife slipped!

l26-02.text: Mario, sit down. Show me. Press here with this clean towel. Hard.
l26-02.es: Mario, sentate. Mostrame. Apretá acá con esta toalla limpia. Fuerte.

l26-04.text: He cut his left hand with a big knife. It's bleeding a lot, here, between the thumb and the first finger.
l26-04.es: Se cortó la mano izquierda con un cuchillo grande. Sangra mucho, acá, entre el pulgar y el índice.

l26-05.text: Keep pressing. I'm calling TMAS. Diego, take his pulse, blood pressure and temperature.
l26-05.es: Seguí apretando. Llamo al TMAS. Diego, tomale el pulso, la presión y la temperatura.

l26-06.text: CIRM Rome, doctor speaking. Good morning. What is the problem?
l26-06.es: CIRM Roma, habla el médico. Buen día. ¿Cuál es el problema?

l26-07.text: Good morning, doctor. This is LNG Horizon. Our cook, fifty years old, cut his left hand with a knife twenty minutes ago.
l26-07.es: Buen día, doctor. Aquí LNG Horizon. Nuestro cocinero, de cincuenta años, se cortó la mano izquierda con un cuchillo hace veinte minutos.

l26-08.text: Has the bleeding stopped? Can he move his fingers?

l26-09.text: The bleeding is slower now. He can move all his fingers, but it hurts.
l26-09.es: Ahora sangra menos. Puede mover todos los dedos, pero le duele.

l26-10.text: Good. What are his vital signs?

l26-11.text: Pulse ninety-two. Blood pressure one hundred and thirty over eighty-five. Temperature thirty-six point eight. Pain seven out of ten.
l26-11.es: Pulso noventa y dos. Presión ciento treinta sobre ochenta y cinco. Temperatura treinta y seis coma ocho. Dolor siete sobre diez.

l26-12.text: Thank you. Clean the wound with saline. Close it with steri-strips and put on a pressure bandage. Give him a painkiller, paracetamol, one gram. No work with that hand for five days. Call me again in six hours.
l26-12.es: Gracias. Limpien la herida con solución fisiológica. Ciérrenla con steri-strips y pongan un vendaje compresivo. Denle un analgésico, paracetamol, un gramo. Nada de trabajo con esa mano por cinco días. Llámenme de nuevo en seis horas.

l26-13.text: Clean with saline, steri-strips, pressure bandage, paracetamol one gram, no work for five days, call back in six hours. Correct?
l26-13.es: Limpiar con solución fisiológica, steri-strips, vendaje compresivo, paracetamol un gramo, nada de trabajo por cinco días, volver a llamar en seis horas. ¿Correcto?

l26-15.text: Five days without work? And who cooks the lunch?
l26-15.es: ¿Cinco días sin trabajar? ¿Y quién cocina el almuerzo?

l26-16.text: Today I'll help in the galley, Mario. You just tell me what to do.
l26-16.es: Hoy te ayudo en la cocina, Mario. Vos decime qué hacer.

sessions.title: Listen: a cut in the galley

screens.title: Calling TMAS
screens.body: There's no doctor on board. When Mario cuts his hand, Tanya calls the radio medical service in Rome, and Diego gives the numbers. Listen first, one piece at a time.
screens.es: Escuchá primero. El texto está escondido a propósito.

screens.title: What happened · how he is · the numbers
steps: It's bleeding. It hurts. He can move his fingers.
Pulse ninety-two · BP one thirty over eighty-five · Temp thirty-six point eight · Pain seven out of ten
paras: Give the doctor the facts in that order: what happened, when, where on the body, how he is now, vital signs.
Blood pressure: two numbers with over in the middle. Temperature: point, not comma.
screens.avoid: He has cut himself the hand · thirty-six comma eight

opts: one hundred and forty over ninety
one hundred and forty on ninety

screens.q: Write the blood pressure like on a form (number/number).
He can move his fingers, but it hurts.

screens.title: his hand, not the hand
paras: In Spanish: se cortó la mano. In English the body part takes his / her / my: He cut his hand.
It hurts: the body part is the subject. Le duele la mano → His hand hurts.
screens.avoid: He cut the hand · It hurts him the hand

screens.q: How often does he take a tablet?

screens.title: wound and temperature
paras: temperature: TEM-pruh-chuh, three syllables. The middle e almost disappears.
list: Temperatura treinta y seis coma ocho.

screens.body: Listen, say it, check it. Slow and clear: the doctor is writing.
screens.es: Despacio y claro: el médico está anotando.
